howItWorks.title: How the portal works
howItWorks.description: From registration to dose confirmation — all online, all traceable.

step1.title: Sign up and request access
step1.desc: Enter your company name, tax ID and fiscal details. Your distributor validates your account and activates your access.

step2.title: Calculate and order
step2.desc: Select the room, crop and destination market. The system suggests the dose and the optimal sachet combination.

step3.title: Apply and verify
step3.desc: Carry out the treatment and upload the MatriSure Kit photo. Dose confirmed, full record.
